decisions.reason: The source changes referral-validation popup behavior and copy, not the separately requested FAQ content; the existing FAQ statement about no-code mints remains valid.
A same-message INTRODUCE already captures both required popup messages exactly; no additional update or removal is needed.
The valid-code popup restates the existing $5 commission and one $500-draw ticket award without changing the coded-referral reward.
The source identifies the ticket awarded for valid and invalid/no-code outcomes but does not change ticket counters, eligibility windows, expiration, or post-draw handling.
The popup copy confirms a $5 referral commission but does not change the established mint price, founder share, affiliate share, or prize-pool allocation.
Restricting validity to already minted NFTs does not change the mint number as the permanent referral-code basis or any display location.
The source changes validation feedback and invalid/no-code reward routing, not dashboard accounting or display of commissions and tickets.
The source reiterates the already-active rule that only previously minted NFT numbers are valid referral codes; it introduces no new validation-state change.
Mentioning one $500 prize-draw ticket does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, eligible population, or draw trigger.
Random selection of an existing NFT holder to receive an invalid/no-code referral reward is distinct from selection of prize-draw winners and does not alter the Chainlink VRF rules.
The source concerns referral-validation popup messages and does not change confirmation-email contents, certificate actions, or ebook access.
The source describes referral reward recipients and popup copy, not prize payout mode, claim interaction, announcements, or winner notifications.
